page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.48xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system architecture is x86_64. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no integrated GPU accelerators. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio represents a design optimized for compute-heavy workloads rather than memory-intensive or storage-heavy tasks.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high core density provide predictable compute resources for parallel processing tasks. The instance is designed for workloads such as high-performance computing, batch processing, compute-heavy web serving, and distributed analytics where CPU capacity is the primary bottleneck and local storage is not required.
